programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: Super Password
programme.desc: Like the 1960s version, two contestants, each teamed with a celebrity partner, compete in a word-association game. The team with the most points at the end of the round gets to go on to a fast-paced bonus round called Cashword.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.title: What Would You Do?
programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. Various scenarios are created that force people to make split-second -- and often surprising -- decisions, and variations of the situation (such as changing the genders, races or clothing of the people involved) are often featured to see if different reactions are elicited. Examples of situations on the show include a waitress being harassed by her boss, and a drunken valet trying to park cars.

programme.desc: Like other Star Fleet vessels, Ship (voice of Malcolm McDowell) has evolved and now controls the only human (Jack Noseworthy) aboard. But the relationship takes a dramatic turn when Man meets Woman and fights machine in a desperate bid for freedom!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Do our memories define our identity? If we are merely the sum of our experiences, what do we become if those experiences are lost? Hope Wilson (Robbie Chong) faces this question when she meets a man who has purposely erased his own memories.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Courtesy of a freak accident (and The Outer Limits), an agoraphobe (Jane Adams) begins to hear the private thoughts of all of the tenants in her building...the good, the bad and the steamy. And it seems at least one of them may want to kill her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A scientist -- who is also a religious zealot (David Ogden Stiers) -- secretly implants an embryo created with DNA from the Shroud of Turin into a young woman (Samantha Mathis) in order to scientifically engineer the Second Coming of Christ.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Outer Limits come to Victorian Whitechapel when a London doctor (Cary Elwes) races to capture the alien creature responsible for the Jack the Ripper murders. But when the alien frames the good doctor for the murders, his time may be up.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The son (Saul Rubinek) of a concentration camp survivor (Peter Boretski) gets some unique help in proving the guilt of a former Nazi (Jan Rubes) living in the U.S....courtesy of a time traveler (Alex Daikun) and, of course, The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The planets Earth and Dregocia struggle to re-establish a fragile trust after a summit goes tragically wrong. Can a diplomat (Marcia Cross) calm the hawkish nature of both species…and can she overcome her own prejudices to save both worlds?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A meek anthropologist (Leland Orser) develops a serum for genetic dominance and tests it on himself. Now his newfound confidence takes complete control of him, turning him into an irrational, overly aggressive troglodyte! Can he reverse the process?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The Haven is a high-tech apartment building which is run by supercomputer and almost completely eliminates the need for human contact. But when things begin to go wrong, neighbors who have never met must learn to work together in order to survive!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist's (Kevin Nealon) experiment unintentionally creates a rift in the space-time continuum, he suddenly find himself caught in a time loop and soon begins to suspects sabotage. Terri Hawkes, Jennifer Copping and Ronny Cox also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A boy (Adam Hann-Byrd) , picked on by high-school bullies and neglected by his own father (Daniel Hugh Kelley), finds comfort in an alien (Chris Potter) who has crash-landed on earth. But is the alien what he claims to be? Never…in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In a world dominated by alien invaders, a cynical American cafe owner (Nathan Fillion) must decide if he will risk his life to help an old lover fight for Earth or if he is happy not rocking the political boat. Derek de Lint also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When Detective Terry Russo (Megan Gallagher) is called to investigate a double murder, she discovers she may be solving not one crime, but possibly hundreds. And that the culprit -- or culprits -- may not be human at all. Michael Riley also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A convicted murderer is turned loose only to be hunted by the sister of his victim as part the hottest show on television, Judgment Day, which allows the family members -- and the at home audience -- to act as judge, jury and executioner!

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An ex-con who had been serving time for spousal abuse is bent on revenge against his wife. He purchases a strange handgun from a gun dealer and finds this is no ordinary weapon and, in fact, he becomes quite attached to it…literally.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A device that allows people to change their appearance helps a nerdy guy become the mirror image of his hunky co-worker.. Now arrogant with his new-found good looks, the former nerd experiences a life like never before…and now he wants to keep it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An invisible alien race that inhabits the energy systems of a deserted spaceship envelopes the crew of a salvage team, responding to the empty vessel's distress signal, in a web of paranoia, suspicion and murder. Michael Shanks stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a scientist uses his time machine to travel into the future, he discovers his wife lying dead in a pool of blood and a man fleeing the scene. Determined save her, he uses the time machine to go back in time...but is her death inevitable?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A blind man (Mackenzie Astin) regains his sight only to be used by the government for his unique ability to see an alien from another dimension who has been trapped on Earth and yearns to return home. But the government has other plans for her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A veterinarian (Jessica Tuck) in a small farming community becomes alarmed when a genetically-engineered corn seed, intended to produce faster, larger yields of corn, produces something far more alarming …human mutations! Len Cariou also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After losing his wife and son in a horrific car accident some twenty years earlier, a scientist (Joel Gray) uses advanced technology to build the perfect robotic version of his son. But perfection is not always so perfect...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Due to dwindling resources in the future, the world consists of "Alphas" and "Betas" who are alternately put in stasis for 72 hour periods, all in service to the "Elites," who lord over the Alphas and the Betas...But a resistance is coming.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When a man arrives at al UFO convention with part of an alien ship, it throws the annual gathering of "true believers" into chaos and leads to a conspiracy, a cover-upï¿½and murder. But who is conspiring with whom? And what are they covering up?

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After being brought back from death, a woman (Laura Leighton) discovers she was one part of a pair of conjoined twins, the other lost during pregnancy. And now that twin, living dormant in her body for all these years, wants a life of her own.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Tom (Tate Donovan) and Wendy (Gabrielle Miller) are the perfect couple, happy and very much in love. But at night, Tom has terrible memory flashes about being stuck in a burning building The nightmares, however, aren't real…and neither is Tom.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After the plane he is traveling in is struck by lightning, a Presidential candidate is visited by a time traveler who tells him that he needs to escape impending death because his presidency is the key to preventing an apocalyptic future.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The crew of a space salvage ship is awakened from hyper-sleep when they come across a mysterious object floating through space. They soon discover the pod contains a tyrant, in stasis, who was banished from Earth for crimes against humanity.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man travels back to his home town in order to investigate his brother's murder, allegedly at the hands of his brother's wife. He quickly discovers his hometown has drastically changed...and the residents seem to be under some form of mind control.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A preacher (Gary Busey), who lost his faith when his wife died, performs staged healing miracles at tent revivals until he finds his faith -- and livelihood -- being tested as never before by the appearance of a mysterious wheelchair-bound man.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Two friends re-enacting the Battle of Gettysburg unwittingly find themselves transported back in time and taken prisoner by a deranged Confederate colonel (Meatloaf) who might not only endanger their future…but the future of the country as well.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A teenage boy (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) suspects that the tenant (Judd Nelson) now taking up residence in his mother's backyard apartment is actually an alien on a deadly mission…a suspicion that puts the boy and his mother in grave danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An anarchist (Frank Whaley), who was once rabidly pro-technology, threatens to blow up the central computers that control the world. As he negotiates with Pete Yastremski (John Amos) to surrender, we discover what led him down this dark path.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When the leader of an Arctic exploration team kills two colleagues, psychologist Jack Burrell (William Cummins) is sent up to counsel the staff, including an old "friend" (Robert Sean Leonard), and to find the cause of an infectious psychosis.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Time-traveler Dr. Theresa Givens (Amanda Plummer) faces the death penalty for using her time machine in a future where all technology is banned due to a devastating nuclear holocaust some 20 years earlier. Charlton Heston also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An overworked father who wants to relieve the tension in his home due to the demands of his job orders a robot to keep house and perform other chores. Much to the father's surprise, the robot starts to replace him as head of the household.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A military colonel travels into the past from a plagued-ridden future where billions have died from a deadly virus. His mission: track down Patient Zero, the woman who had all three strains of DNA that produced the virus and assassinate her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A couple and their friend join a mysterious religious sect in order to lead a more spiritual existence and find a new direction in life. They soon learn, however, that their new-found direction may take them further than they ever thought possible.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Young and artistic Claire Linkwood, who struggles financially to make ends meet, volunteers for a surrogate mother program. But after the embryo is successfully implanted at the clinic, she begins to have nightmares of a most "alien" nature.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: The lone survivor (Jere Burns) of a space shuttle disaster discovers he's greatly transformed since surviving the crash. For one, his body seems to be indestructible, and he embraces a new-found humanity…courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: Mona Lisa, an android who was created to spy and kill, is designed with superior intelligence. But it is that superior intellect which allows her to evolve, leading her to question the morality of her prime directive...and her own existence.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A biogeneticist clones successfully his wife, who is near death in a coma with no expectation of survival. But when his real wife suddenly awakens from her coma, he finds life with not one, but two wives may be quite complicated.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A man (Enrico Colantoni) has second thoughts about a process that transmits a copy of a person light years away but requires that the human "shell" left behind be destroyed in order to maintain a balance in the Universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An unemployed man wanders into a curio shop owned by a shape-shifting alien and is offered a rather unique wallet...one that fills with the money of anyone the man comes in physical contact with. However, if it's too good to be true, it often is.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A dying scientist (Joanna Going) makes it her mission to save a mutant "child" -- a link to another dimension of time and space -- from those scientists who seek fame and from shadowy government forces that desire to exploit it.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A four-person space crew travels through a wormhole that lands them in an unknown universe where Native American Astrophysicist Callie Whitehorse Landau experiences bizarre hallucinations that reveal the true nature of the entire universe.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien seed travels through space and lands on Earth in a rooftop garden, the exotic "flower" it spawns turns out to be an alluring woman who consumes the life and energy out of human victims in the attempt to perpetuate her species on Earth.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: After a botched military experiment some four years earlier resulted in the death of one of the test subjects, a doctor now believes the deceased test subject's vengeful spirit is able to jump from one body to another…and is after her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: In an effort to help the mentally ill, a psychiatrist (Jamie Lunar) creates a device that allows her to enter the subconscious of her patients. But when things go wrong, she finds that her own sanity -- and possibly her life -- may be in danger.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A time traveler recruits a young woman from present day to join a team of time travelers-for-hire, but when she ends up attempting to change her own past, doing irreparable damage to the present and the future, the institute must race to stop her.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: When an alien abducts five students and transports them to a reproduction of their school, it informs them that they are part of a grand experiment. But as part of that experiment, together they must decide which of the five should be killed.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A circuit court judge (Dennis Haysbert) agrees to preside over a case on a colonized planet that has never had any organized rule of law. On a world in which humans and aliens live side by side, he finds his first case is one of murder.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A desperate high school wrestling coach gives his team an untested performance-enhancing inhalant. Of course, the team suddenly starts winning…but their victory may be short-lived as the drug comes with killer side effects.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: An employee of a computer company uncovers a plot by its CEO/founder to take control of the world's computer network by having computers communicate at a more sentient level and, if successful, set himself up for world domination.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A woman who was abducted by aliens 17 years earlier tries to move past the mental scars, especially for the sake of her daughter, and finds love with a new teacher at her daughter's school. But she soon learns he is not the man he appears to be.

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A rogue android who is part of the crew on Ganymede outpost threatens to destroy Earth's last hope of survival, claiming that human beings are no better than an infestation in the universe and not worthy of survival. And perhaps he is right….

programme.title: Outer Limits - NEW
programme.desc: A test to find the right soldier for a secret mission pushes the limits of each of the candidates. Placed in seemingly real and very dangerous situations, the candidates soon find the line between reality and simulation inexorably blurred.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Cliff Robertson stars as a radio station owner who builds a three-dimensional television receiver which accidentally intercepts a "galaxy being" whose strange form and deadly radiation triggers a tide of panic and violence!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Hundred Days Of The Dragon
programme.desc: In a terrifyingly timely story of genetic engineering and political power plays, Sidney Blackmer stars as a popular American President who puts into place a master plan to slowly and steadily destroy the United States. James Hong also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In order to unifying the nations of Earth, a group of scientists sets out to secretly create the ultimate, global threat -- an all-powerful alien monster -- via human mutation! Robert Culp stars as the scientist chosen to undergo the transformation.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A meek, unassuming college professor (Donald Pleasence) invents a device capable of controlling the entire electro-magnetic spectrum and realizes the device has unleashed his subconscious thirst for revenge—with uncontrollable and deadly results!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: The Man Who Was Never Born
programme.desc: Martin Landau stars as the time-traveler Andro who is desperately trying to stop the birth of a crazed 20th century inventor whose bacterium invention turns humans into hideous mutants. Shirley Knight co-stars in this classic, touching episode.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Both a cautionary tale and a tight courtroom drama, this haunting episode explores the fear and hostility that result when all privacy is eliminated...and all secrets are revealed! Jeff Corey, Peter Breck and Alan Baxter star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In an isolated, snowbound outpost where a handful of people are on alert against enemy attack, a crazed Army major (Harry Guardino) is haunted by the ghost of a soldier he left to die. Sally Kellerman co-stars in one of her earliest TV appearances.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Two rock samples in Dr. Temple's (Barry Atwater) lab conceal protoplasmic alien invaders capable of controlling a human "corpus." Enter Paul Cameron (Robert Culp)...who can telepathically hear the "rocks" plotting their take-over of the world.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A six-man strike force is captured on the planet Ebon and brutally interrogated. And when they are suddenly allowed the "respect due a conquered enemy," the prisoners to conclude that there is a traitor among them...someone who must be killed!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: It Crawled Out Of The Woodwork
programme.desc: Writer-producer Joseph Stefano creates both a macabre parable of the destructive potential of nuclear energy and a pulsating tale of terror featuring a superbly understated performance by Ed Asner. Scott Marlow and Michael Forrest also star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In this highly charged, fascinating tale that explores the concept of alternate dimensions, a wealthy industrialist (Barry Jones) attempts to contact his dead son by funding a scientist's experiments in prying open the door to "the borderland.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: They creep. They crawl. They kill. When the rulers of the planet Zanti are allowed to exile their criminals to our world, the screeching misfits will demonstrate to the military just what the word "invasion" really means. Bruce Dern stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Befuddled by the strange local custom of murder, two Martian administrators (Barry Morse and Carroll O'Connor) visit Earth to study one such crime and find themselves tempted to tamper with events in this whimsical tale from "The Outer Limits.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Film great Miriam Hopkins (1932's "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde) returns to the screen to give a show-stopping performance as an overly ripe flapper who will stop at nothing to complete her long overdue wedding night scenario. John Hoyt also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In one of the series' most unnerving episodes, Don Gordon portrays a secret government agent who infiltrates the ranks of the Invisibles -- a subversive, underground society of the nation's power brokers who are possessed by alien parasites.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Martin Landau and Sally Kellerman star as an inventor and his ambitious wife in a parable about aspiration's devolution into greed when a failed experiment leads to the interception of a powerful alien being from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When four brilliant young men born and raised in Spider County suddenly vanish and a fifth is accused of a murder he didn't commit, the boy receives a unique invitation from an alien being who is willing to take him to a home very, very far away.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Ruth Roman, Alex Nicol and Tim O'Connor star in this compelling study of allegiance and sacrifice as a group of lunar astronauts discover a strange space vessel full of fugitives from another world…and they have a desperate story to tell.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Sent to investigate a strange situation on a possibly habitable planet, Dr. Evan Marshall (Larry Pennell) discovers the scientific team sent there is now dominated by a human mutant (Warren Oates) who can exist without sleep and kill by touch!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A drifter wanders into an eerie mansion and finds himself ill-at-ease amongst the eccentric cast of occupants, all of whom may just be part of some strange scientific study…from the dark recesses of the Outer Limits. Gloria Grahame stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: The politics of indoctrination are disturbingly portrayed -- and the Outer Limits is brought closer to home -- as a couple (Macdonald Carey, Marion Ross) welcome their son's new tutor into their home…a tutor whose motives may just be alien invasion!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.sub-title: Production And Decay Of Strange Particles
programme.desc: An emergency at a nuclear power plant sets the wheels of man's possible destruction into horrifying motion as radiation gone wild tears open a dimensional hole in the reactor! George MacReady stars as the scientist who struggles to find a solution!

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Robert Duvall stars as a CIA agent sent on a mission to infiltrate a downed space craft and kill the creatures inside. Mutated to appear as they do, he soon learns that the shape in which a man finds his own humanity is not always a human one.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Vera Miles and Barbara Rush stars as two women who kill a ruthless blackmailer. Fleeing from their crime, they stumble across an eccentric inventor (David McCallum) obsessed with returning the dead to life….including the man the women murdered.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In Harlan Ellison's first ever science fiction teleplay, Michael Ansara portrays a man born and bred to be a killing machine who finds himself without a war when a time warp sends him from a future earth to the present day. Lloyd Nolan also stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: Star Trek's William Shatner stars as the first man to successfully land on Venus. But when he suddenly starts craving heat -- more heat than humans can stand -- it is just the beginning of a nightmare brought back from The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a 2-dimensional being, Eck, becomes trapped in our 3-dimensional world, a certain lens made from meteoric quartz is its only hope of an escape from the confines of Earth. Peter Lind Hayes, Joan Freeman and Parley Baer star.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When funding is suddenly cut off for a research project where "expanded humans" are created with consciousness-raising drugs, Star Trek's James Doohan and Skip Homier find themselves prey to science run amok in this suspense-laden "whodunit.".

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: In a role written for him by Harlan Ellison, Robert Culp stars as Trent, a man from the future who escapes back into our present. Pursued by an alien race which has conquered future Earth -- the fate of all humankind lies in Trent's glass hand.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: For Andy Thorne (Eddie Albert) and his wife, Karen (June Havoc), an innocent drive into the countryside turns into a living nightmare when they become trapped in a remote canyon ruled by a strange alien force with which they cannot communicate.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a professor (Patrick O'Neal) manages to clone a distant planet in miniature, he introduces human DNA into the ecosystem. What is spawned, however, are the darkest, most horrific aspects of Earth's troubled development. Dabney Coleman co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: This classic episode finds a robot on trial for the murder of the scientist who created him. Leonard Nimoy stars as the cock-sure reporter who coaxes a crusty lawyer (Howard Da Silva) out of retirement to defend the accused. Ford Rainey co-stars.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: A frustrated scientist (Warren Stevens) receives an offer he cannot refuse when an alien creature (Robert Webber) offers to provide him with the answers he seeks. In return, the scientist must hand over all of his human emotions...including love.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a highly dangerous and illegal alien creature escapes from scientist Henderson James' lab, he clones himself to kill the beast. But if the clone is not destroyed before James' memories set in, James may find his cozy life in jeopardy.

programme.title: Outer Limits - ORIGINAL
programme.desc: When a long-duration spaceflight simulation is invaded by an alien presence, the six astronauts inside begin turning on one another as the being preys on each of their darkest fears! Or is this all just part of the simulation...a test?

programme.title: Count Duckula: Amnesiac Duck

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures
programme.desc: Bill and Ted are discouraged when their fourth concert bombs and decide to give up music and the Wyld Stallions. Without telling the boys that their decision will jeopardize the future,
programme.sub-title: When The Going Gets Tough...Bill And Ted Are History

programme.title: Count Duckula: There are Werewolves at the Bottom of Our Garden
programme.desc: The castle's werewolf has escaped and it's up to Igor and Nanny to get it back before Duckula finds out.
programme.sub-title: There are Werewolves at the Bottom of Our Garden

programme.title: Count Duckula: The Lost Valley
programme.desc: Duckula, Igor and Nanny go to watch a film called 'The Lost Valley'.

programme.title: THE NEW PINK PANTHER SHOW
programme.desc: 'A Nut at the Opera': When stage hand Pinky accidentally puts the opera's star tenor out of commission and must take over the lead himself. 'Hamm-N-Eggz': Hamm and Eggz royally mess up the wedding of the obnoxious daughter of a Mafioso hit-man.

programme.title: THE NEW PINK PANTHER SHOW
programme.desc: 'Home Stretch Pinky': Horse trainer Pinky tries to help Granny win the Kentucky Fedora - the world's famous horse race. 'Pink Pucks': To win a big hockey game, Pink conjures up Slusho to play goalie, only to have him lured away by an ice seductress.

programme.title: Count Duckula: Vampire Vacation
programme.desc: Duckula travels to Spain to meet his arsonist cousin and fights the deadliest bull in Spain.

programme.title: Count Duckula: The Rest is History
programme.desc: Duckula travels back in time to stop the first Count Duckula from becoming a vampire.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures
programme.desc: Bill and Ted's adventures take them to the North Pole with Admiral Byrd, ancient Egypt, and King Tut, and finally to Dr. Livingston in the African jungles as they search for a rare exotic bird.
programme.sub-title: Birds Of A Feather Stick To The Roof Of Your Mouth

programme.title: Pink Panther & Pals: Pink Pool Fool
programme.desc: Finding the skate park is closed, Pink Panther tries to skate in a drained-swimming pool, but Big Nose won't let his plans to go swimming be ruined.

programme.title: Danger Mouse
programme.desc: Danger Mouse and Penfold are caught up in lightning storm that causes Penfold to spill the test tube's contents and transports them to the future where the world is ruled by cats who are taking orders from Big Leo.

programme.title: Bill & Ted's Excellent Adventures
programme.desc: Bill and Ted find themselves with a problem: how to get part-time jobs when they have no experience. They manage to get references from Marie Antoinette and Lucretia Borgia but decide that working on music is preferable to working at a real job.
programme.sub-title: A Job, A Job, My Kingdom For A Job

programme.title: Count Duckula: Dr. Von Goosewing's Invisible Ray
programme.desc: Dr Von Goosewing, along with his new invisible ray, invades the castle in another attempt to kill Duckula

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El Maestro Karin les cuenta a Son Gohan y Krilín que el Agua Ultradivina se encuentra en el palacio del Todopoderoso, pero no cuentan con un obstáculo inesperado... ¡Piccolo convertido en demonio y dispuesto a eliminarles!
programme.sub-title: ¡Confrontación directa con Piccolo! Un Masenko lleno de rabia en el Cielo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Son Gohan y Krilín apenas no pueden defenderse, ya que Garlick ha aprisionado al Todopoderoso y a Poppo y amenaza con eliminarles. Piccolo no vuelve en sí y Gohan está a punto de perder la vida...
programme.sub-title: ¡Todo el mundo debe volver en sí! El agua sagrada del Templo de Dios

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilín y Piccolo han engañado a Garlick y aprovechan la confusión para robarle las botellas donde ha encerrado al Todopoderoso y a Poppo. A Poppo se le ocurre una idea para que el Agua Ultradivina cumpla su cometido.
programme.sub-title: ¡Mañana será demasiado tarde! Dios emprende una acción suicida

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El demonio Garlick se ha convertido en un poderoso gigante que recibe cada vez más poder de la Estrella de la Magia Negra. Además todos sus secuaces son ahora más peligrosos que antes y el combate se complica cada vez más.
programme.sub-title: ¡La victoria requiere medidas extremas! Dios rompe la ley sagrada

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La Estrella de la Magia Negra ya está muy cerca de la Tierra y el combate contra Garlick no tiene fin. Son Gohan es un rival muy digno, pero la inmortalidad del enemigo es el mayor problema, porque aunque le venzan, se levantará una y otra vez...
programme.sub-title: ¡El agua sagrada funciona! El mundo despierta de la pesadilla

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de la batalla con Garlick, los guerreros vuelven a su vida habitual. Krilín con su novia Maron, Son Gohan vuelve a sus estudios y Piccolo no cesa su vigilancia. El Maestro Tortuga les llama a todos para celebrar el cumpleaños de su tortuga
programme.sub-title: ¡Una breve posibilidad de victoria para Gohan! Derrota al mundo demoníaco

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Krilin busca la manera de proponerle matrimonio a Marron.
programme.sub-title: Eres un hombre ¿no?... La proposición 101ª de Krilin

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Un año después de la batalla de Namek, Gohan y sus amigos detectan una energía increíblemente poderosa y maligna que se acerca a la Tierra. Sus peores temores se confirman cuando descubren que Freeza ha sobrevivido.
programme.sub-title: Ésa es la Tierra, papá... Freeza padre e hijo contraatacan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: A falta de tres horas para que Goku regrese, la Tierra se enfrenta a la peor de las crisis en la forma de un revivido Freeza acompañado por su padre. Pero justo cuando todo parece perdido, aparece un misterioso joven que les planta cara.
programme.sub-title: Yo derrotaré a Freeza... El misterioso joven que espera a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando Freeza y su padre aterrizan en la Tierra, lo único que se interpone entre ellos y su diabólica venganza es un muchacho desconocido. Pero el joven héroe demuestra ser más de lo que aparenta al transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡Freeza partido en dos de un solo golpe! Aparece otro Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras acabar fácilmente con Freeza y su padre, el misterioso Super Saiyan anuncia el lugar y la hora exacta de llegada de Goku a la Tierra. Pero cuando Goku llega tal y como ha predicho, él tampoco parece tener ni idea de quién es el joven.
programme.sub-title: Ey, cuánto tiempo... Son Goku regresa

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El enigma que envuelve al Super Saiyan misterioso queda finalmente resuelto. Se trata de Trunks, hijo de Bulma y Vegeta, que ha viajado veinte años hacia atrás en el tiempo para advertir a Goku de una terrible amenaza que aguarda en el futuro.
programme.sub-title: Mi padre es Vegeta. La confesión del misterioso joven

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Goku pone a sus amigos al corriente de la profecía el joven del futuro según la cual aparecerán dos enemigos terroríficos al cabo de tres años. Todos deciden entrenarse a fondo en los tres años que faltan para la llegada de los androides.
programme.sub-title: ¿La nueva técnica especial de Goku? Mirad mi Cambio de Lugar Instantáneo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Advertidos por el joven del futuro, Goku, Piccolo, Gohan, Vegeta y el resto de Guerreros Z comienzan un duro entrenamiento de tres años para que el futuro infernal del que procede Trunks jamás llegue a hacerse realidad.
programme.sub-title: ¡Superaré a Goku! El rey de la raza guerrera saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras haberse enfrentado al mismísimo Freeza y haber salvado la Tierra en numerosas ocasiones, Goku se enfrenta ahora al desafío más grande de su vida: sacarse el permiso de conducir para no tener que hacer frente a la ira de Chichi.
programme.sub-title: ¿Sacarse el permiso? El nuevo desafío de Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Han pasado tres años y el día fatídico finalmente ha llegado. Tal y como había predicho Trunks, los androides aparecen y Yamcha se convierte en la primera víctima de la masacre. ¿Cuál es el terrible poder oculto de los androides?
programme.sub-title: Asesinos que no dejan rastro. ¿Quiénes son los androides?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando los Guerreros Z finalmente localizan a los androides, el despiadado nº 20 les provoca destruyendo la mitad de la ciudad. Goku responde a los androides sorprendiéndoles con una transformación en Super Saiyan llena de rabia.
programme.sub-title: Las atrocidades del sanguinario Nº 20. La supertransformación llena de rabia de Son Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Super Saiyan Goku y el Nº 19 comienzan a librar una intensa batalla. Pero cuando Goku comienza a perder terreno y a comportarse de un modo extraño, Gohan comprende que es debido a la enfermedad cardíaca que predijo Trunks.
programme.sub-title: ¡La doble conmoción de Goku! Atrapado entre la enfermedad y la adversidad

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Afectado por una enfermedad cardíaca viral, Goku se encuentra indefenso frente al Androide Nº 19. Pero justo entonces aparece Vegeta y sorprende a todos demostrando que él también es capaz de transformarse en Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡El poder de Vegeta! Despierta la sangre de un Super Saiyan

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: En su primera batalla como Super Saiyan, Vegeta aplasta literalmente al Nº 19, pero el Nº 20 escapa y se esconde entre las montañas. Ahora, los Guerreros Z deben encontrarle antes de que pueda llevar a cabo sus diabólicos planes.
programme.sub-title: La risa desafiante del Nº 20... El secreto del Dr. Gero

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Vegeta, Piccolo, Gohan y compañía continúan la búsqueda de un Nº 20 más dispuesto a ser el cazador que la presa. Mientras tanto, Trunks regresa a tiempo de descubrir que el pasado ha cambiado y no necesariamente para mejor.
programme.sub-title: ¿Una realidad aún más aterradora que el futuro? La sospecha de Trunks

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La revelación de que el Nº 19 es el Dr. Gero y que los androides que convierten el futuro en un infierno son el Nº 17 y el Nº 18 hace que sea más importante que nunca encontrar el laboratorio secreto antes de que el científico regrese a él.
programme.sub-title: ¡Hay que dar con él! La búsqueda del misterioso laboratorio del Dr. Gero

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cuando los Guerreros Z finalmente encuentran el laboratorio secreto del Dr. Gero, Vegeta, desoyendo el sensato consejo de Trunks, permite que el científico active a los Androides Nº 17 y Nº 18, que no tardan en tomar el control de la situación.
programme.sub-title: Y los temores se hacen realidad... ¡El Nº 17 y el Nº 18 despiertan!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los Androides Nº 17 y Nº 18, e incluso el Nº 16 del que ni siquiera Trunks había oído hablar, han sido finalmente activados. ¿Existirá alguien capaz de impedir que cumplan el objetivo de asesinar a Goku para el que han sido programados?
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Es demasiado tarde para hacer algo?! El arma definitiva para matar a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: La terrible batalla entre Super Saiyan Vegeta y la Nº 18 finalmente ha dado comienzo. A pesar de que Trunks y los otros desean intervenir, Vegeta insiste en luchar solo contra un enemigo que aparentemente no tiene ningún punto débil.
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Atractiva y superpoderosa?! La Nº 18 no tiene ningún punto débil

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Después de que Vegeta sea humillado por la Nº 18, Trunks, Piccolo y Ten Shin Han deciden intervenir y sufren el mismo destino que él. Para los androides todo parece ser un juego que tiene como premio final la cabeza de Goku.
programme.sub-title: Nadie puede detenerles... ¡¿Es el fin de los Guerreros Z?!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Frente al inconcebible poder de los androides, los orgullos heridos dejan paso a las medidas desesperadas. Piccolo tiene intención de volver a ser uno de nuevo con Dios para adquirir un poder que rivalice con el de los Super Saiyans.
programme.sub-title: ¡La decisión de Piccolo! El último as bajo la manga

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Sin prisa pero sin pausa, los androides se van acercando cada vez más a un Goku convaleciente e indefenso. Klilyn y los otros deciden trasladar a su amigo inconsciente a la Kame House para protegerlo de la amenaza de los androides.
programme.sub-title: ¡Las super-armas de destrucción masiva andantes! Los androides se aproximan a Goku

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras nuestros amigos trasladan a Goku, Bulma se pone en contacto con ellos para advertirles de la aparición de una segunda máquina del tiempo que da pie a un nuevo misterio: ¿quién ha viajado en ella y con qué propósito?
programme.sub-title: ¡Un mal presagio! Bulma revela un misterio

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras investigan la segunda máquina del tiempo, Bulma, Trunks y Klilyn encuentran un huevo y una muda de cuerpo. La extraña criatura que ha llegado del futuro anda suelta y parece augurar tiempos terribles para la Tierra.
programme.sub-title: ¡El descubrimiento de un huevo maligno! Trunks aterrorizado

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Frente a la amenaza de un enemigo sin precedentes, Dios y Piccolo deciden volver a ser uno dando nacimiento al Super Namek. Finalmente, el monstruo misterioso se deja ver y trae consigo un sorprendente secreto.
programme.sub-title: Enfrentados a un enemigo sin precedentes... ¡El nacimiento del Super Namek!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: El abominable monstruo llegado del futuro que absorbe la vida de la gente parece poseer la energía y los ataques de Goku. ¿Será el nuevo y poderoso namek nacido de la fusión de Dios y Piccolo capaz de detenerle antes de que sea tarde?
programme.sub-title: ¡¿Kame Hame ha?! La energía de Goku está en el monstruo

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras Piccolo lucha por sobrevivir contra él, el monstruo del futuro revela que es Cell, un androide concebido por el ordenador del Dr. Gero que ha viajado hacia atrás en el tiempo para absorber al Nº 17 y a la Nº 18 y alcanzar la forma perfecta.
programme.sub-title: ¡La forma de vida de odio y destrucción! El nombre del androide es Cell

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Tras engañar a Cell para que le revelara su identidad y sus planes, Piccolo regenera el brazo y se prepara para el siguiente asalto. Con todo en su contra, Cell emplea una táctica de subterfugio para seguir adelante con sus planes.
programme.sub-title: ¡El lamentable grave error de Piccolo! ¡Cell anda suelto por la ciudad!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Mientras Cell aumenta cada vez más de poder asesinando a una persona tras otra, Trunks y Klilyn visitan el subterráneo del laboratorio del Dr. Gero y encuentran los planos del Nº 17 que pueden permitir encontrar su punto débil.
programme.sub-title: ¡El secreto del nacimiento de Cell! ¿Qué se esconde bajo el laboratorio?

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Cell continúa sembrando el terror con el único objetivo de asimilar al Nº 17 y a la Nº 18. Por su parte, Goku finalmente se recupera de su enfermedad y comprende que la única forma de salir airosos de esta crisis es ir más allá del Super Saiyan.
programme.sub-title: ¡Goku despierta para la batalla! ¡Hay que ir más allá del Super Saiyan!

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Los saiyans comienzan a entrenar en la Sala del Espíritu y el Tiempo, donde pueden conseguir el entrenamiento de todo un año en un solo día. Pero antes de que haya transcurrido un solo día, los androides llegan al fin a la Kame House.
programme.sub-title: ¡Acelerad el entrenamiento, saiyans! En la Sala del Espíritu y el Tiempo...

programme.title: Dragon Ball Z
programme.desc: Dispuesto a aguantar hasta el regreso de los saiyans, Piccolo se enfrenta al Nº 17. Pero los peores temores están a punto de hacerse realidad cuando Cell detecta la energía desplegada por el Super Namek y se pone en movimiento.
programme.sub-title: El Gekiretsu Kodan que parte en dos el cielo. Piccolo contra el Androide Nº 17
